integrity: The first-order average is reconstructed directly from the printed rescaled ODE and inverse linear change. Exact-rational witnesses and the stability polynomial are replayed by the bundled checker. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local first-order result for the simple positive-radius branch only; no nonexistence claim for other periodic orbits, no assessment of zero-radius averaged labels, and no global-dynamics claim.
title: Correct first-order averaging for the positive-radius zero-Hopf branch
